# Outside libraries.
# Each one is taken from the system if it is installed (FIND_PACKAGE_ARGS), otherwise downloaded.
# Who may use which library is in ai/code-structure.md and checked by tools/check_layers.py.

include(FetchContent)
set(FETCHCONTENT_QUIET OFF)
# Some libraries still ask for very old CMake versions; CMake 4 refuses that without this.
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
# Libraries found on the system must be visible to every module, not only to this folder.
set(CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL ON)

# --- SDL3: window, input, OpenGL context (used only by platform) ---
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(SDL3
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git
  GIT_TAG        release-3.4.20
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
  FIND_PACKAGE_ARGS CONFIG)

# --- GLM: math with GLSL names (used everywhere through base/math.hh) ---
set(GLM_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLM_BUILD_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(glm
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/g-truc/glm.git
  GIT_TAG        1.0.3
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
  FIND_PACKAGE_ARGS)

# --- nlohmann/json: preferences, save/load (used through base/json.hh) ---
FetchContent_Declare(nlohmann_json
  URL https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.tar.xz
  FIND_PACKAGE_ARGS)

# --- doctest: unit tests ---
set(DOCTEST_WITH_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DOCTEST_WITH_MAIN_IN_STATIC_LIB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(doctest
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/doctest/doctest.git
  GIT_TAG        v2.5.3
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
  FIND_PACKAGE_ARGS)

# --- Dear ImGui: widgets (used only by ui; its SDL backend by platform) ---
FetchContent_Declare(imgui
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git
  GIT_TAG        v1.92.9b
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE)

# --- glad 2: OpenGL function loader (used only by gpu). Needs Python with jinja2. ---
FetchContent_Declare(glad
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad.git
  GIT_TAG        v2.0.8
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
  SOURCE_SUBDIR  cmake)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(SDL3 glm nlohmann_json doctest imgui glad)

# ImGui has no CMake build of its own: one core library and one per backend.
add_library(imgui STATIC
  ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui.cpp
  ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
  ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
  ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp
  ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_demo.cpp)
target_include_directories(imgui PUBLIC ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR})

add_library(imgui_backend_sdl3 STATIC ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp)
target_include_directories(imgui_backend_sdl3 PUBLIC ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends)
target_link_libraries(imgui_backend_sdl3 PUBLIC imgui SDL3::SDL3)

add_library(imgui_backend_opengl3 STATIC ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp)
target_include_directories(imgui_backend_opengl3 PUBLIC ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends)
target_link_libraries(imgui_backend_opengl3 PUBLIC imgui ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})

# OpenGL 3.3 core functions, generated by glad.
glad_add_library(glad_gl_core_33 STATIC REPRODUCIBLE API gl:core=3.3)

# main() for the test programs.
if(SDFE_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_library(sdfe_test_main STATIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/doctest_main.cc)
  target_link_libraries(sdfe_test_main PUBLIC doctest::doctest)
endif()
